name: Where the Spotlight Lingers
source:
Feeling lost? Don't worry, all you are supposed to see is right here. Don't stare too long where it's dark, we don't want anything unplanned to happen to you...

You are Vern, an assistant to the acrobats that one night saw something they shouldn't have. Now nothing feels right and more questions seem to appear.

And the biggest question is: Who really is the Contortionist Flo? Or maybe it's better to ask... what really is he...?

[from [url=https://virusap.itch.io/where-the-spotlight-lingers]itch.io[/url]]
